intent.statement: Replace AI Translation report/state persistence with one strict authoritative translated_text.json document; preserve chunk-level resume, current-profile budgeting, minimal response validation, debounced review edits, non-destructive retranslation, existing broad downstream reset policy, and approved-translation downstream gating; provide no migration or compatibility for prior translation artifacts.

spec_items.statement: AI Translation persists exactly one authoritative translated_text.json object with target_language, status, token_usage, budget_metadata, additional_translation_instructions, and minimal chunks containing only chunk_id, translated_text, and approved; legacy report/state files and legacy shapes are unsupported.

Starting or continuing translation synchronizes canonical chunk IDs in source order, resumes at the first empty translated_text, preserves completed chunks, reuses saved general instructions for running/in_progress/cancelled/failed work, and recalculates budget metadata from the currently selected profile.

Cancellation or provider failure preserves completed chunks and cumulative token usage with cancelled or failed status, while successful selected-chunk retranslation replaces text only after validation and failed or cancelled retranslation preserves the previous text and approval.

Manual review derives counts and overall status from canonical source chunks, debounces edits for approximately 750 milliseconds, flushes on selection change or approval, writes once per review action, and reaches completed only when every non-empty translation is approved.

AI Translation page-state construction is read-only, incompatible or malformed translation JSON raises a reset-required error without overwrite, manifest summaries are derived in the controller, and downstream translated-language consumers accept only completed translation.

Translation prompts keep stable literary and multilingual dialogue-preservation rules in the system prompt while the user prompt contains target language, one optional instruction block, source text, and the single translated_text JSON response shape without duplicate rule blocks.
